resources.string: BestFoneFinder collects location data to send this phone\'s position by SMS when someone texts BFF where, even when the app is closed or not in use.
Allow location while BFF is closed

Optional. On the next screen, open Permissions → Location and choose “%1$s”. This lets BFF answer an authorized location SMS when the app is closed. You can keep approximate location. Return to BFF when finished. Skipping turns off location replies.
BFF-Answer: getting a location fix. A final update will follow.
BFF-Answer: unable to obtain a recent location. Check that location services are enabled and try again.
BFF-Answer: recent location %1$s (±%2$d m; fix %3$d seconds old).
BFF-Answer: final location update %1$s (±%2$d m; fix %3$d seconds old).
BFF-Answer: Could not start location access. Open BFF to review permissions.
Set a 4 to 8 digit PIN before enabling a PIN rule.
Sharing the download link for this installation.
Here is BFF, the app to find your phone! https://bestfonefinder.cloud
Someone is looking for this phone. Tap to start the alarm.
Someone is looking for this phone. Tap FOUND to stop.
Send SMS stays off. BFF needs permission to send SMS.
Location stays off. BFF needs location access.
Location stays off. BFF needs “Allow all the time” so it can answer while the phone is in a pocket.
Android no longer shows this prompt for BFF. On the next screen, open Permissions → %1$s and choose Allow. Return to BFF when finished.
BFF works by SMS. Android treats SMS access as sensitive.
BFF requires SMS receive to work. Please enable it in Settings.
On Pixel, Allow can be greyed out. Then: Settings → Apps → BFF → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, and come back.
Tap Allow. If Samsung shows “Restricted setting”: Settings → Apps → BFF → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, and come back.
Tap Allow. If Allow is greyed out: Settings → Apps → BFF → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, and come back.
Tap Allow. If Xiaomi warns about a risky permission, tap Allow anyway. Also: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → BFF → Autostart on.
Tap Allow. If blocked: Settings → Apps → BFF → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Also allow Auto-launch under Battery.
Tap Allow when Android asks. If Allow is greyed out: Settings → Apps → BFF → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.

Lock this phone. From another phone allowed in Privacy settings, send a real SMS with %1$s (and your PIN if required). Check that this phone rings for %2$d seconds. If it does not, open Help or Settings › Permissions. Repeat after a restart and a longer idle period. Location is optional in Settings › Location.
BFF sends back an SMS with the phone location. Allow Android to send SMS.
Install or enable a web browser to open the BFF help guide.
These settings can help BFF ring while locked. Enable them now, or continue and test your phone. If the test fails, return to Settings → Permissions.

Start recording, lock this phone, then send one test SMS from another phone. Return here and tap Refresh, then copy or share the report. Recording stops after 30 minutes and keeps only 150 events. Starting again replaces the previous trace. No message text, phone numbers, PINs or location are recorded. The local siren test checks audio while this app is open; it does not test SMS delivery or locked-phone behavior.
This plays a loud siren at maximum alarm volume for five seconds. Keep the phone away from your ears. Your previous alarm volume will be restored.
